# Find Campaign

> Search CrowdChange campaigns server-side with rich filters and retrieve a paginated list of matching fundraisers with goal, raised, and status data.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/fundraisers/search`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `text` (string, body) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, body) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, body) — Number of results to return. Default: `100`
- `sort` (string, body) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, body) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `email` (string, body) — Email filter.
- `status` (string, body) — Campaign status. Allowed values: `approved`, `pending`
- `is_hidden` (boolean, body) — True if campaign is hidden, otherwise false.
- `created_at` (object, body) — Campaign's creation date filter.
  - `<` (string, body)
  - `<=` (string, body)
  - `=` (string, body)
  - `>=` (string, body)
  - `>` (string, body)
- `amount_goal` (object, body) — Campaign's amount goal filter.
  - `<` (number, body)
  - `<=` (number, body)
  - `=` (number, body)
  - `>=` (number, body)
  - `>` (number, body)
- `amount_raised` (object, body) — Campaign's amount raised filter.
  - `<` (number, body)
  - `<=` (number, body)
  - `=` (number, body)
  - `>=` (number, body)
  - `>` (number, body)
- `after_id` (integer, body) — Return teams after Team ID.
- `lang` (string, body) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `filter_by_lang` (integer, body) — Filter campaigns only available in locale
- `tags` (string[], body) — List of fundraiser tags.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `partner_id` (integer) — Site ID.
- `name` (string) — Campaign name.
- `created_at` (string) — Campaign creation date.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the campaign.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount attributed to the campaign. This amount is included in `amount_raised` until the offline donation is received.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Amount contributed by donation matching assigned directly to the campaign. Team- and personal-page-level matching is not included.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
- `dt_start` (string) — Date and time when campaign starts.
- `dt_end` (string) — Date and time when campaign ends.
- `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
- `location` (string | null) — Display location. Uses the legacy event address when no display value exists.
- `location_details` (string | null) — Location instructions or free-form text stored on the campaign.
- `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `url` (string) — URL to campaign.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of donors.
- `n_teams` (integer) — Number of teams.
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of pages.
- `status` (string) — Campaign's approval status. Allowed values: `approved`, `pending`
- `status_code` (string) — Campaign's activity status code. Allowed values: `live`, `deleted`, `archived`, `pending_approval`, `opening_soon`, `closed`
- `is_hidden` (boolean) — True if campaign is hidden, otherwise false.
- `auto_open_at` (string) — Date when campaign is scheduled to auto-open
- `auto_close_at` (string) — Date when campaign is scheduled to auto-close
- `closed_at` (string) — Date when campaign was closed
- `archived_at` (string) — Date when campaign was archived
- `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `in_support_name` (string) — Value of `In support of` field associated with campaign.
- `in_support_code` (string) — Code provided for `In support of` field.
- `appeal_code` (string) — Appeal code.
- `user` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign owner's ID
  - `name` (string) — Campaign owner's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Campaign owner's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Campaign owner's last name
  - `title` (string) — Campaign owner's title
  - `email` (string) — Campaign owner's email
- `organization` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
  - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
  - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
- `fundraiser_template` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Template ID.
  - `name` (string) — Template Name.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to original campaign's image.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — List of custom questions and responses.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field id.
  - `source_id` (integer) — If field was copied from Blueprint, this will reference the source field id from blueprint (similar to group id).
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string) — User's answer to custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID.
  - `response_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID for the response (multiple choice questions).
- `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**


# Find Team

> Search CrowdChange fundraising teams server-side with rich filters and retrieve a paginated list with captain, goal, and raised totals for each.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/teams/search`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `text` (string, body) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, body) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, body) — Number of results to return. Default: `100`
- `sort` (string, body) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, body) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `email` (string, body) — Email filter.
- `created_at` (object, body) — Team's creation date filter.
  - `<` (string, body)
  - `<=` (string, body)
  - `=` (string, body)
  - `>=` (string, body)
  - `>` (string, body)
- `amount_goal` (object, body) — Team's amount goal filter.
  - `<` (number, body)
  - `<=` (number, body)
  - `=` (number, body)
  - `>=` (number, body)
  - `>` (number, body)
- `amount_raised` (object, body) — Team's amount raised filter.
  - `<` (number, body)
  - `<=` (number, body)
  - `=` (number, body)
  - `>=` (number, body)
  - `>` (number, body)
- `fundraiser_id` (integer, body) — Campaign ID filter.
- `after_id` (integer, body) — Return teams after Team ID.
- `lang` (string, body) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `filter_by_lang` (integer, body) — Filter teams only available in locale
- `tags` (string[], body) — List of fundraiser tags.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `transaction_id` (integer) — Transaction ID (if was created through transaction).
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount attributed to the team, including its personal pages. This amount is included in `amount_raised` until the offline donation is received.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Amount contributed by donation matching assigned directly to the team. Personal-page-level matching is not included.
- `created_at` (string) — Creation date
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `fundraiser` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Fundraiser ID
  - `partner_id` (integer) — Site ID.
  - `fundraiser_template_id` (integer) — Template ID.
  - `name` (string) — Fundraiser name
  - `url` (string) — Fundraiser URL
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Fundraiser goal amount.
  - `user` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Fundraiser owner's ID
    - `email` (string) — Fundraiser owner's email
    - `first_name` (string) — Fundraiser owner's first name
    - `last_name` (string) — Fundraiser owner's last name
    - `title` (string) — Fundraiser owner's title
    - `name` (string) — Fundraiser owner's name
  - `fundraiser_template` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Template ID.
    - `name` (string) — Template Name.
  - `dt_start` (string) — Date and time when campaign starts.
  - `dt_end` (string) — Date and time when campaign ends.
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Display location. Uses the legacy event address when no display value exists.
  - `location_details` (string | null) — Location instructions or free-form text stored on the campaign.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
  - `organization_name` (string) — Organization associated with campaign.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
- `user` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Team captain's ID
  - `email` (string) — Team captain's email
  - `first_name` (string) — Team captain's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Team captain's last name
  - `title` (string) — Team captain's title
  - `name` (string) — Team captain's name
- `custom_data` (object[]) — List of custom questions and responses.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field id.
  - `source_id` (integer) — If field was copied from Blueprint, this will reference the source field id from blueprint (similar to group id).
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string) — User's answer to custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID.
  - `response_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID for the response (multiple choice questions).
- `team_captain_mailing_address` (object) — Team captain's mailing information. This can be registrant's address, or mailing address, or billing address.
  - `address` (string) — Street Address.
  - `city` (string) — City.
  - `state` (string) — State or province.
  - `zip` (string) — Zip or Postal code.
  - `country` (string) — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `url` (string) — Full URL to team's page.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "transaction_id": 12345678,
    "name": "Team A",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_raised": 550,

      "tags_list": [
        "tag1",
```

# Find Personal Page

> Search CrowdChange personal fundraising pages server-side with rich filters and retrieve a paginated list with goal, raised, and owner details.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/personal-pages/search`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `text` (string, body) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, body) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, body) — Number of results to return. Default: `100`
- `sort` (string, body) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, body) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `email` (string, body) — Email filter.
- `created_at` (object, body) — Page's creation date filter.
  - `<` (string, body)
  - `<=` (string, body)
  - `=` (string, body)
  - `>=` (string, body)
  - `>` (string, body)
- `amount_goal` (object, body) — Page's amount goal filter.
  - `<` (number, body)
  - `<=` (number, body)
  - `=` (number, body)
  - `>=` (number, body)
  - `>` (number, body)
- `amount_raised` (object, body) — Page's amount raised filter.
  - `<` (number, body)
  - `<=` (number, body)
  - `=` (number, body)
  - `>=` (number, body)
  - `>` (number, body)
- `fundraiser_id` (integer, body) — Campaign ID filter.
- `after_id` (integer, body) — Return teams after Page ID.
- `lang` (string, body) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `filter_by_lang` (integer, body) — Filter pages only available in locale
- `tags` (string[], body) — List of fundraiser tags.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `transaction_id` (integer) — Transaction ID (if was created through transaction).
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount attributed to the personal page. This amount is included in `amount_raised` until the offline donation is received.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Amount contributed by donation matching assigned directly to the personal page.
- `created_at` (string) — Creation date
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `team` (object) — Team name that personal page belongs to (if assigned to a team).
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team's goal amount.
  - `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `custom_data` (object[]) — List of custom questions and responses.
    - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field id.
    - `source_id` (integer) — If field was copied from Blueprint, this will reference the source field id from blueprint (similar to group id).
    - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
    - `content` (string) — User's answer to custom field.
    - `field_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID.
    - `response_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID for the response (multiple choice questions).
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to team's page.
- `fundraiser` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Fundraiser ID
  - `partner_id` (integer) — Site ID.
  - `fundraiser_template_id` (integer) — Template ID.
  - `name` (string) — Fundraiser name
  - `url` (string) — Fundraiser URL
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Fundraiser goal amount.
  - `user` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Fundraiser owner's ID
    - `email` (string) — Fundraiser owner's email
    - `first_name` (string) — Fundraiser owner's first name
    - `last_name` (string) — Fundraiser owner's last name
    - `title` (string) — Fundraiser owner's title
    - `name` (string) — Fundraiser owner's name
  - `fundraiser_template` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Template ID.
    - `name` (string) — Template Name.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
- `user` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Team captain's ID
  - `email` (string) — Team captain's email
  - `first_name` (string) — Team captain's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Team captain's last name
  - `title` (string) — Team captain's title
  - `name` (string) — Team captain's name
- `custom_data` (object[]) — List of custom questions and responses.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field id.
  - `source_id` (integer) — If field was copied from Blueprint, this will reference the source field id from blueprint (similar to group id).
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string) — User's answer to custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID.
  - `response_custom_id` (string) — Custom ID for the response (multiple choice questions).
- `url` (string) — Full URL to personal page.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json

  {
    "id": 1,
    "transaction_id": 12345678,
```

# Get Campaign

> Retrieve detailed server-side information about a CrowdChange campaign by its fundraiser ID, including configuration, goal, raised, and donor stats.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/fundraiser/{id}`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Fundraiser ID.

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `partner_id` (integer) — Site ID.
- `name` (string) — Campaign name.
- `description` (string | null) — Campaign description.
- `url` (string | null) — Full URL to the campaign.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the campaign.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, including the currency symbol.
- `goal_type` (string) — Campaign goal type.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount attributed to the campaign.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Amount contributed by donation matching assigned directly to the campaign.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of donors.
- `n_teams` (integer) — Number of teams in the campaign.
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages in the campaign.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original campaign image.
- `image` (string | null) — Campaign image ID.
- `start_at` (string | null) — Campaign start date and time.
- `end_at` (string | null) — Campaign end date and time.
- `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Campaign creation date and time.
- `user` (object) — Campaign owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
  - `id` (integer) — Organization ID.
  - `name` (string) — Organization name.
  - `custom_id` (string) — Organization custom ID.
- `closed_at` (string | null) — Campaign close date and time.
- `is_hidden` (boolean) — Whether the campaign is hidden.
- `fundraiser_template` (object | null) — Campaign template summary, when applicable.
  - `id` (integer) — Template ID.
  - `name` (string) — Template name.
- `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
- `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
- `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "partner_id": 10,
  "name": "Campaign",
  "description": "Description",
  "created_at": "2022-01-01 16:00:03",
```

# Get Campaign Teams

> Search teams registered under a CrowdChange campaign by keyword and retrieve a paginated list with captain, goal, and raised totals for each.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/fundraiser/{id}/teams`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Fundraiser ID.

## Query parameters

- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `100`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `type` (string) — Team type.
- `url` (string | null) — URL to the team's page.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the team.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Team matched donation amount.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of team donors.
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages on the team.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original team image.
- `image` (string | null) — Team image ID.
- `description` (string | null) — Team description.
- `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the team image is inherited from the campaign.
- `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the team description is inherited from the campaign.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Team creation date and time.
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `user` (object) — Team owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json

  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Team A",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_pledged": 125,
```

# Create Offline Transaction

> Record an offline donation transaction against a CrowdChange campaign on behalf of a donor, including amount, payment method, and donor details.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/fundraiser/{id}/offline-donations`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.

## Body

- `amount` (number, body) — Full amount of offline transaction in xxx.xx format.
- `name` (string, body) — Donor's full name.
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer, body) — Team ID.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer, body) — Page ID.
- `email` (string, body) — Donor's email.
- `is_lump_sum` (boolean, body) — Whether the transaction is recorded as a lump sum.
- `is_pending` (boolean, body) — Whether the transaction is pending.
- `pay_method` (string, body) — Payment method used for the offline transaction.
- `comment` (string, body) — Comment associated with the transaction.
- `billing` (object, body) — Billing information.
  - `first_name` (string, body) — Donor's First Name.
  - `last_name` (string, body) — Donor's Last Name.
  - `business_name` (string, body) — Business Name
  - `is_foundation` (boolean, body) — Whether the donation is made by a foundation.
  - `address` (string, body) — Street Address.
  - `city` (string, body) — City.
  - `state` (string, body) — State or province.
  - `zip` (string, body) — Zip or Postal code.
  - `country` (string, body) — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
  - `phone` (string, body) — Donor's phone number.

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Transaction ID.
- `user_id` (integer) — Donor ID.
- `email` (string) — Donor email.
- `amount` (number) — Full amount.
- `currency` (string) — Currency code. Allowed values: `CAD`, `USD`, `AUD`, `EUR`
- `fundraiser_id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer) — Page ID.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": 123123,
  "user_id": 120120,
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "amount": 49.95,
  "currency": "USD",
  "fundraiser_id": 1,
  "fundraiser_team_id": 1,
  "fundraiser_page_id": 1
}
```

# Get offline transactions

> Retrieve a paginated list of offline donation transactions recorded against a CrowdChange campaign, including amount, donor, and entry metadata.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/fundraiser/{id}/offline-donations/list`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.

## Query parameters

- `status` (string, query) — Transaction status. Allowed values: `received`, `pending`
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer, query) — Campaign's Team.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer, query) — Campaign's Personal Page.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Transaction ID.
- `amount` (number) — Amount.
- `amount_total` (number) — Amount Total.
- `currency` (string) — Currency code. Allowed values: `CAD`, `USD`, `AUD`, `EUR`
- `is_pending` (boolean) — True if transaction is pending.
- `pledge_code` (string) — Pledge code.
- `tax_eligible_amount` (number) — Tax Eligible Amount.
- `has_tax_receipt` (boolean) — True if transaction has tax receipt.
- `created_at` (string) — Transaction creation date.
- `billing` (object) — User's billing information.
  - `business_name` (string) — Business name.
  - `is_foundation` (boolean) — Is this transaction made by foundation?
  - `title` (string) — Honorific (i.e. Mr / Miss / etc).
  - `name` (string) — Full user name including honorific.
  - `first_name` (string) — User's first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User's last name.
  - `street_address` (string) — Street name and number.
  - `city` (string) — City name.
  - `country` (string) — Country code.
  - `state` (string) — State or province..
  - `postal` (string) — ZIP or Postal Code.
  - `email` (string) — User's email address.
- `fundraiser_page` (object) — Personal Page.
  - `id` (integer) — Personal Page ID.
  - `name` (string) — Personal Page name.
- `fundraiser_team` (object) — Team.
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
- `tax_receipt` (object) — Tax receipt information.
  - `id` (integer) — Unique id.
  - `amount_donation` (number) — Total donation amount.
  - `amount_benefit` (number) — Benefit amount.
  - `amount_eligible` (number) — Eligible amount.
  - `name_on_receipt` (string) — Name on receipt.
  - `issued_on` (string) — Date when the tax receipt was issued.
  - `receipt_number` (string) — Tax receipt number
  - `title` (string) — Honorific (i.e. Mr / Miss / etc).
  - `first_name` (string) — First name.
  - `last_name` (string) — Last name.
  - `street_address` (string) — Street name and number.
  - `city` (string) — City name.
  - `country` (string) — Country code.
  - `state` (string) — State or province..
  - `postal` (string) — ZIP or Postal Code.
  - `email` (string) — Email address.
- `transaction_meta` (object) — Meta information.
  - `is_lump_sum` (boolean) — True if it is a lump sum.
  - `is_foundation` (boolean) — Is this transaction made by foundation?

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "amount": 100,
    "amount_total": 100,
    "currency": "USD",
    "is_pending": false,
    "pledge_code": "PLEDGE_CODE",
    "tax_eligible_amount": 100,
    "has_tax_receipt": false,
    "created_at": "2024-01-01 16:00:03",
    "billing": {
      "business_name": "Company Inc",
      "is_foundation": false,
      "title": "Mr.",
      "name": "Mr. John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "street_address": "100 Main Street",
      "city": "Toronto",
      "country": "CA",
      "state": "ON",

    "fundraiser_page": {

      "id": 1001,

      "id": 1001,
      "amount_donation": 100.99,
      "amount_benefit": 10.49,
      "amount_eligible": 90.5,

      "receipt_number": "TAX-0012345",
      "title": "Mr.",
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/server-side/user-specific-apis/post_v2-private-user-login | Nav: API Reference > Server Side APIs > User-Specific APIs > Sign In | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Sign In

> Authenticate a CrowdChange user and receive an auth token for user-specific API calls, including the two-factor authentication challenge flow.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/user/login`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `email` (string, body, **required**) — User's email.
- `password` (string, body, **required**) — User's password.
- `method` (string, body) — Method of 2FA. Required if the first login attempt asks to use 2FA. Allowed values: `sms`, `email`, `authApplication`
- `mfa_code` (string, body) — 2FA code sent to user. Required if the first login attempt asks to use 2FA.

## Response

- `token` (string) — Auth token to User-specific API. Presented if log in process is successful. Expired after 30 days if not used.
- `user_id` (integer) — User ID. Presented if log in process is successful.
- `email` (string) — Disguised user email. Presented if user needs to use 2FA and has email 2FA method.
- `phone` (string) — Disguised user Phone. Presented if user needs to use 2FA and has sms 2FA method.
- `method` (string) — Default 2FA method. Presented if user needs to use 2FA.
- `active_methods` (any[]) — Available 2FA methods to user. Presented if user needs to use 2FA.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "token": "1|WQaSlvm1Gl8Pscq0e98K5MQPhiV8Q07CT9t8vR0N",
  "user_id": 10,
  "email": "a***n@crowdchange.co",
  "phone": "Campaign",
  "method": "Description",
  "active_methods": [
    "email",
    "sms",
    "authApplication"
  ]
}
```

# Sign Out

> Invalidate the current CrowdChange auth token to sign the authenticated user out of the active session on a single device or client.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/user/logout`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `token` (string, body, **required**) — User's access token.

## Response

- `status` (string) — Status of the operation.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

# Sign Out All Devices

> Invalidate every active auth token for the authenticated CrowdChange user, signing them out of all devices and sessions in a single call.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/user/logout/all`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `email` (string, body, **required**) — User's email.

## Response

- `status` (string) — Status of the operation.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/server-side/user-specific-apis/post_v2-private-user-upload-image | Nav: API Reference > Server Side APIs > User-Specific APIs > Upload Image | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Upload Image

> Upload an image file to CrowdChange on behalf of the authenticated user, returning a hosted URL you can attach to personal pages or teams.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/user/upload/image`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `file` (string, body, **required**) — base-64 encoded image.

## Response

- `id` (string) — Image ID
- `url` (string) — URL to uploaded image
- `success` (boolean) — Flag if uploading is successful
- `message` (string) — Message if uploading is unsuccessful

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
  "url": 10,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Campaign"
}
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/server-side/user-specific-apis/get_v2-private-user-fundraisers | Nav: API Reference > Server Side APIs > User-Specific APIs > Get Campaigns | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Get Campaigns

> Retrieve a paginated list of CrowdChange campaigns where the authenticated user is registered, including role, goal, and amount raised per campaign.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/user/fundraisers`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `token` (string, query, **required**) — User's access token.
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `partner_id` (integer) — Site ID.
- `name` (string) — Campaign name.
- `description` (string | null) — Campaign description.
- `url` (string | null) — Full URL to the campaign.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the campaign.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, including the currency symbol.
- `goal_type` (string) — Campaign goal type.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount attributed to the campaign.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Amount contributed by donation matching assigned directly to the campaign.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of donors.
- `n_teams` (integer) — Number of teams in the campaign.
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages in the campaign.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original campaign image.
- `image` (string | null) — Campaign image ID.
- `start_at` (string | null) — Campaign start date and time.
- `end_at` (string | null) — Campaign end date and time.
- `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Campaign creation date and time.
- `user` (object) — Campaign owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
  - `id` (integer) — Organization ID.
  - `name` (string) — Organization name.
  - `custom_id` (string) — Organization custom ID.
- `closed_at` (string | null) — Campaign close date and time.
- `is_hidden` (boolean) — Whether the campaign is hidden.
- `fundraiser_template` (object | null) — Campaign template summary, when applicable.
  - `id` (integer) — Template ID.
  - `name` (string) — Template name.
- `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
- `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
- `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "partner_id": 10,
    "name": "Campaign",
    "description": "Description",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "amount_pledged": 125,
    "amount_matched": 50,
    "goal_type": "amount",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2",
    "language": "en",
    "start_at": "2022-01-01 16:00:03",
    "end_at": "2022-01-02 16:00:03",
    "tags_list": ["tag1", "tag2"],
    "custom_data": [
      {
        "field_id": 1001,
        "source_id": 11,
        "name": "Phone Number",
        "content": "555-123-4567",
        "field_custom_id": "ABC-123",
        "response_custom_id": null
      }
    ],
    "is_hidden": false,
    "closed_at": "2022-03-01 00:00:00",
    "user": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr.",
      "email": "john@crowdchange.co",
      "contact_email": "john@crowdchange.co"
    },
    "organization": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Crowdchange",
      "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
    },
    "images": {
      "original": "https://img.crowdchange.co/files/abc.png?tr=w-[width],h-[height]"
    }
  }
]
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/server-side/user-specific-apis/get_v2-private-user-personal-pages | Nav: API Reference > Server Side APIs > User-Specific APIs > Get Personal Pages | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Get Personal Pages

> Retrieve a paginated list of the authenticated user's personal fundraising pages across all CrowdChange campaigns, with goals and raised amounts.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/user/personal-pages`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `token` (string, query, **required**) — User's access token.
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `type` (string) — Personal page type.
- `url` (string | null) — URL to the personal page.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the personal page.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Personal page matched donation amount.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of personal page donors.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original personal page image.
- `image` (string | null) — Personal page image ID.
- `description` (string | null) — Personal page description.
- `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the personal page image is inherited from the campaign.
- `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the personal page description is inherited from the campaign.
- `registrant` (object | null) — Registrant details, when available.
  - `first_name` (string) — Registrant first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — Registrant last name.
- `archived_at` (string | null) — Personal page archive date and time.
- `closed_at` (string | null) — Personal page close date and time.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Personal page creation date and time.
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `user` (object) — Personal page owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
- `team` (object | null) — Team summary, when the personal page belongs to a team.
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the team page.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team goal amount.
  - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted team goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team.
  - `language` (string) — Team language.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "John Snow",
    "description": "Personal page description",
    "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2/page/1",
    "language": "en",
    "custom_data": [
      {
        "field_id": 1001,
        "source_id": 11,
        "name": "Phone Number",
        "content": "555-123-4567",
        "field_custom_id": "ABC-123",
        "response_custom_id": null
      }
    ],
    "is_default_image": false,
    "is_default_description": false,
    "images": {
      "original": "https://img.crowdchange.co/files/abc.png?tr=w-[width],h-[height]"
    },
    "team": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1/team/2",
      "language": "en"
    },
    "fundraiser": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1",
      "language": "en",
      "organization": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Crowdchange",
        "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
      }
    },
    "user": {
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr."
    }
  }
]
```

# Get Teams

> Retrieve a paginated list of CrowdChange fundraising teams the authenticated user belongs to, including role, campaign, goal, and raised totals.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/user/teams`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `token` (string, query, **required**) — User's access token.
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `type` (string) — Team type.
- `url` (string | null) — URL to the team's page.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the team.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Team matched donation amount.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of team donors.
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages on the team.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original team image.
- `image` (string | null) — Team image ID.
- `description` (string | null) — Team description.
- `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the team image is inherited from the campaign.
- `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the team description is inherited from the campaign.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Team creation date and time.
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `user` (object) — Team owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/server-side/user-specific-apis/get_v2-private-user-fundraiser-id-team-teamid-personal-pages | Nav: API Reference > Server Side APIs > User-Specific APIs > Get Team's Personal Pages | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Get Team's Personal Pages

> Retrieve a paginated list of personal fundraising pages registered under the authenticated user's team within a CrowdChange campaign.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/user/fundraiser/{id}/team/{teamId}/personal-pages`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.
- `teamId` (integer, path, **required**) — Team ID.

## Query parameters

- `token` (string, query, **required**) — User's access token.
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `type` (string) — Personal page type.
- `url` (string | null) — URL to the personal page.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the personal page.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Personal page matched donation amount.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of personal page donors.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original personal page image.
- `image` (string | null) — Personal page image ID.
- `description` (string | null) — Personal page description.
- `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the personal page image is inherited from the campaign.
- `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the personal page description is inherited from the campaign.
- `registrant` (object | null) — Registrant details, when available.
  - `first_name` (string) — Registrant first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — Registrant last name.
- `archived_at` (string | null) — Personal page archive date and time.
- `closed_at` (string | null) — Personal page close date and time.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Personal page creation date and time.
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `user` (object) — Personal page owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
- `team` (object | null) — Team summary, when the personal page belongs to a team.
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the team page.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team goal amount.
  - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted team goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team.
  - `language` (string) — Team language.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "John Snow",
    "description": "Personal page description",
    "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2/page/1",
    "language": "en",
    "custom_data": [
      {
        "field_id": 1001,
        "source_id": 11,
        "name": "Phone Number",
        "content": "555-123-4567",
        "field_custom_id": "ABC-123",
        "response_custom_id": null
      }
    ],
    "is_default_image": false,
    "is_default_description": false,
    "images": {
      "original": "https://img.crowdchange.co/files/abc.png?tr=w-[width],h-[height]"
    },
    "team": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1/team/2",

    "fundraiser": {
      "id": 1,

      "language": "en",

      "contact_email": "john@example.com",
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr."
    }
  }
]
```

# Update Personal Page

> Update the authenticated user's personal fundraising page within a CrowdChange campaign, including title, story, goal, and cover image.

**Endpoint:** `PUT /v2/private/user/fundraiser/{id}/personal-page/{pageId}`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.
- `pageId` (integer, path, **required**) — Personal Page ID.

## Body

- `token` (string, body, **required**) — User's access token.
- `name` (string, body) — Personal Page's name
- `amount_goal` (number, body) — Personal Page's goal amount
- `description` (string, body) — Personal Page's description
- `image` (string, body) — Personal page's image ID

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `type` (string) — Personal page type.
- `url` (string | null) — URL to the personal page.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the personal page.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Personal page matched donation amount.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of personal page donors.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original personal page image.
- `image` (string | null) — Personal page image ID.
- `description` (string | null) — Personal page description.
- `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the personal page image is inherited from the campaign.
- `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the personal page description is inherited from the campaign.
- `registrant` (object | null) — Registrant details, when available.
  - `first_name` (string) — Registrant first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — Registrant last name.
- `archived_at` (string | null) — Personal page archive date and time.
- `closed_at` (string | null) — Personal page close date and time.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Personal page creation date and time.
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `user` (object) — Personal page owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
- `team` (object | null) — Team summary, when the personal page belongs to a team.
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the team page.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team goal amount.
  - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted team goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team.
  - `language` (string) — Team language.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

# Update Team

> Update the authenticated user's CrowdChange fundraising team within a campaign, including name, description, goal, and team cover image.

**Endpoint:** `PUT /v2/private/user/fundraiser/{id}/team/{teamId}`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.
- `teamId` (integer, path, **required**) — Team ID.

## Body

- `token` (string, body, **required**) — User's access token.
- `name` (string, body) — Team's name
- `amount_goal` (number, body) — Team's goal amount
- `description` (string, body) — Team's description
- `image` (string, body) — Team's image ID

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `type` (string) — Team type.
- `url` (string | null) — URL to the team's page.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, including the currency symbol.
- `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the team.
- `amount_matched` (number) — Team matched donation amount.
- `n_donors` (integer) — Number of team donors.
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages on the team.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to the original team image.
- `image` (string | null) — Team image ID.
- `description` (string | null) — Team description.
- `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the team image is inherited from the campaign.
- `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the team description is inherited from the campaign.
- `created_at` (string | null) — Team creation date and time.
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
- `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
  - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
  - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
  - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
  - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
  - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
  - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
- `user` (object) — Team owner.
  - `id` (integer) — User ID.
  - `name` (string) — User name.
  - `email` (string) — User email.
  - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
  - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
  - `title` (string) — User title.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Team A",
  "description": "Team description",
  "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
```

# Page Donors List

> Retrieve a paginated list of donors for the authenticated user's personal page within a campaign, returning 10 donors per page with amount details.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/user/fundraiser/{id}/personal-page/{pageId}/donors`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.
- `pageId` (integer, path, **required**) — Personal Page ID.

## Query parameters

- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `amount` Default: `id`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc` Default: `desc`
- `only_received` (integer, query) — Include only received transactions. Default: `0`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `amount` (number) — Donation amount
- `amount_match` (number) — Matched amount for campaigns with donation matching enabled.
- `name` (string) — Donor's name or alias.
- `date` (string) — Date and time of donation
- `contact_email` (string) — Donor's email
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer) — Page ID.
- `comment` (string) — Donor's comment.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "amount": 100,
    "amount_match": 100,
    "name": "John Snow",
    "date": "2021-01-01 00:00:00",
    "contact_email": "john@example.com",
    "fundraiser_team_id": 1,
    "fundraiser_page_id": 1,
    "comment": "Comment"
  }
]
```

# Create Offline Transaction

> Record an offline donation transaction on behalf of the authenticated user against a CrowdChange campaign, with amount and donor details.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/user/fundraiser/{id}/offline-donation`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key + user token — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header, plus the user token in the `auth-token` header or `token` param  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Campaign ID.

## Body

- `token` (string, body, **required**) — User's access token.
- `amount` (number, body, **required**) — Full amount of offline transaction in xxx.xx format.
- `fundraiser_id` (integer, body, **required**) — Campaign ID.
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer, body) — Team ID.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer, body) — Page ID.
- `email` (string, body) — Donor's email.
- `business_name` (string, body) — Business Name
- `billing` (object, body) — Billing information.
  - `first_name` (string, body) — Donor's First Name.
  - `last_name` (string, body) — Donor's Last Name.
  - `address` (string, body, **required**) — Street Address.
  - `city` (string, body, **required**) — City.
  - `state` (string, body, **required**) — State or province.
  - `zip` (string, body, **required**) — Zip or Postal code.
  - `country` (string, body, **required**) — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Transaction ID.
- `user_id` (integer) — Donor ID.
- `email` (string) — Donor email.
- `amount` (number) — Full amount.
- `currency` (string) — Currency code. Allowed values: `CAD`, `USD`, `AUD`, `EUR`
- `fundraiser_id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer) — Page ID.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": 123123,
  "user_id": 120120,
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "amount": 49.95,
  "currency": "USD",
  "fundraiser_id": 1,
  "fundraiser_team_id": 1,
  "fundraiser_page_id": 1
}
```

# Team Donors List

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/user/fundraiser/{id}/team/{teamId}/donors`

**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

- `teamId` (integer, path, **required**) — Team ID.

## Query parameters

- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `amount` Default: `id`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc` Default: `desc`
- `only_received` (integer, query) — Include only received transactions. Default: `0`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `amount` (number) — Donation amount
- `amount_match` (number) — Matched amount for campaigns with donation matching enabled.
- `name` (string) — Donor's name or alias.
- `date` (string) — Date and time of donation
- `contact_email` (string) — Donor's email
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer) — Page ID.
- `comment` (string) — Donor's comment.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json

  {
    "amount": 100,
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/server-side/webhooks/post_v2-private-webhooks-subscribe | Nav: API Reference > Server Side APIs > Webhooks > Subscribe Webhook | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Subscribe Webhook

> Register a new CrowdChange webhook subscription pointing at your target URL to start receiving event payloads from the fundraising platform.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/webhooks/subscribe`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Body

- `url` (string, body, **required**) — URL to subscribe. Provided URL should return 200 HTTP-code in order to be subscribed.
- `lang` (string, body) — Webhook locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr` Default: `en`
- `events` (string[], body) — Events for subscription. Allowed values: `fundraiser_created`, `fundraiser_updated`, `fundraiser_deleted`, `transaction_created`, `transaction_refunded`, `fundraiser_team_created`, `fundraiser_team_updated`, `fundraiser_team_deleted`, `fundraiser_page_created`, `fundraiser_page_updated`, `fundraiser_page_deleted`, `tax_receipt_issued`, `milestone_triggered`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Webhook ID.
- `url` (string) — Webhook URL.
- `signing_secret` (string) — Webhook-specific secret used to verify `CrowdChange-Webhook-Signature` on outbound deliveries. Store this value securely.
- `language` (string) — Webhook language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `created_at` (string) — Webhook creation date.
- `events` (object[]) — List of subscribed events.
  - `id` (integer) — Event ID.
  - `name` (string) — Event name
  - `created_at` (string) — Event creation date.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | URL is not available (does not return 200 HTTP-code) |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.test/webhooks/handle",
  "signing_secret": "whsec_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789ab",
  "language": "en",
  "created_at": "2024-01-01 16:00:03",
  "events": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "fundraiser_created",
      "created_at": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

# Get webhooks

> Retrieve a paginated list of every CrowdChange webhook subscription registered on your account, with target URL, subscribed events, and status.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/webhooks`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `q` (string, query) — Search term.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Webhook ID.
- `url` (string) — Webhook URL.
- `signing_secret` (string) — Webhook-specific secret used to verify `CrowdChange-Webhook-Signature` on outbound deliveries. Store this value securely.
- `language` (string) — Webhook language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `created_at` (string) — Webhook creation date.
- `events` (object[]) — List of subscribed events.
  - `id` (integer) — Event ID.
  - `name` (string) — Event name
  - `created_at` (string) — Event creation date.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.test/webhooks/handle",
    "signing_secret": "whsec_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789ab",
    "language": "en",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01 16:00:03",
    "events": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "fundraiser_created",
        "created_at": "string"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

- `events` (object[]) — List of subscribed events.

  - `created_at` (string) — Event creation date.

# Get logs

> Retrieve a paginated log of webhook delivery attempts for a CrowdChange webhook subscription, including event type, status, and response details.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/private/webhooks/{webhookId}/logs`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `webhookId` (integer, path, **required**) — Webhook ID.

## Query parameters

- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `event` (string, query) — Event name. Allowed values: `fundraiser_created`, `fundraiser_updated`, `fundraiser_deleted`, `transaction_created`, `transaction_refunded`, `fundraiser_team_created`, `fundraiser_team_updated`, `fundraiser_team_deleted`, `fundraiser_page_created`, `fundraiser_page_updated`, `fundraiser_page_deleted`, `tax_receipt_issued`, `milestone_triggered`

See [Event payloads](event-payloads.md) for the JSON payload sent to your webhook URL and stored in each log entry.

Each delivery attempt has its own `id`. The `payload_hash` identifies the normalized payload shared by attempts with the same event data. Use it with [Resend event by payload hash](post_v2-private-webhooks-id-logs-hash-payloadhash-resend.md) to replay the newest matching delivery.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Log entry ID.
- `webhook_id` (integer) — Webhook ID.
- `webhook_event_id` (integer) — Webhook Event ID.
- `payload_hash` (string | null) — MD5 fingerprint of the normalized payload. This is `null` for logs created before payload hashes were added.
- `created_at` (string) — Event sent date.
- `code` (integer) — HTTP-code of response from your server.
- `payload` (object) — Payload sent to your server.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "webhook_id": 1,
    "webhook_event_id": 1,
    "payload_hash": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01 16:00:03",
    "code": 200,
    "payload": {}
  }
]
```
