# Resend logged event

> Resend a previously logged CrowdChange webhook event to its subscriber URL, useful for retrying failed deliveries or debugging webhook handlers.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/webhooks/{webhookId}/logs/{logId}/resend`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `webhookId` (integer, path, **required**) — Webhook ID.
- `logId` (integer, path, **required**) — Log ID.

## Response

- `status` (string) — Status of the operation. Check the logs if you want to know the HTTP-code returned by your server.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

# Resend event by payload hash

> Resend the newest logged CrowdChange webhook delivery that matches a payload hash, creating a new delivery attempt with the same payload.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/webhooks/{webhookId}/logs/hash/{payloadHash}/resend`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `webhookId` (integer, path, **required**) — Webhook ID.
- `payloadHash` (string, path, **required**) — The 32-character MD5 fingerprint returned as `payload_hash` by [Get logs](get_v2-private-webhooks-id-logs.md).

This endpoint finds the newest log for the webhook with the specified `payload_hash` and resends its `event` and `data` payload.

The resend creates a new delivery attempt with a new log `id` and the same `payload_hash`. The payload hash is a lookup value and does not replace the `CrowdChange-Webhook-Signature` header used to verify webhook authenticity.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |
| `404` | No matching webhook log found |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

# Send event

> Trigger a CrowdChange webhook to fire an event payload based on an existing entity, useful for testing endpoints and replaying historical data.

**Endpoint:** `POST /v2/private/webhooks/{webhookId}/events/send`  
**Surface:** Server Side API (server-to-server only; never call from a browser) · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `webhookId` (integer, path, **required**) — Webhook ID.

## Body

- `id` (integer, body, **required**) — Entity ID. (Campaign/Transaction/Tax Receipt/Team/Personal Page/Milestone log)
- `event` (string, body, **required**) — Event name. Allowed values: `fundraiser_created`, `fundraiser_updated`, `fundraiser_deleted`, `transaction_created`, `transaction_refunded`, `fundraiser_team_created`, `fundraiser_team_updated`, `fundraiser_team_deleted`, `fundraiser_page_created`, `fundraiser_page_updated`, `fundraiser_page_deleted`, `tax_receipt_issued`, `milestone_triggered`

## Replaying deletion and refund events

The event must be subscribed on the webhook, and the entity must be accessible to the authenticated partner.

| Event | Body `id` |
| - | - |
| `fundraiser_deleted` | Deleted campaign ID |
| `fundraiser_team_deleted` | Deleted team ID |
| `fundraiser_page_deleted` | Deleted personal page ID |
| `transaction_refunded` | Refund transaction ID with `status: "refunded"` and a `parent_id` |

Deletion events require an entity that has already been deleted. Refund events accept both full and partial refund records.

This endpoint builds a payload from the current entity data. For refunds, the original payment in `data.parent` reflects its current stored state, including any later refunds. To resend a saved payload, use [Resend event](post_v2-private-webhooks-id-logs-logid-resend.md).

## Response

- `status` (string) — Status of the operation. Check the logs if you want to know the HTTP-code returned by your server.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `401` | Unauthorized |
| `403` | Forbidden |
| `404` | Entity not found, inaccessible, or does not match the selected event |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

# Event payloads

> Reference the JSON payloads sent by CrowdChange webhook events.

CrowdChange sends webhook deliveries as JSON with an `event` name and event-specific `data`.
The same object is stored on webhook logs as `payload`. Events are delivered to subscribed webhooks for the campaign's partner and, when applicable, its distinct parent partner.

```json
{
  "event": "transaction_created",
  "data": {}
}
```

## Updated event changes

The `fundraiser_updated`, `fundraiser_team_updated`, and `fundraiser_page_updated` events include a `changes` object in `data`.

- `changes` (object) — Changed fields keyed by dot notation. Each changed field contains `old` and `new` values.

```json
{
  "changes": {
    "name": {
      "old": "Old campaign name",
      "new": "New campaign name"
    }
  }
}
```

## Deleted event details

The `fundraiser_deleted`, `fundraiser_team_deleted`, and `fundraiser_page_deleted` events include the deleted entity's usual fields plus `deleted_at` in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

When deleting a team also deletes its personal pages, each deleted page produces a `fundraiser_page_deleted` event. Pages moved back to the campaign remain active and do not produce a deletion event.

This example shows only the deletion fields; the other campaign fields are described below.

```json
{
  "event": "fundraiser_deleted",
  "data": {
    "id": 1001,
    "deleted_at": "2026-10-07 16:00:03"
  }
}
```

## Campaign events

Events: `fundraiser_created`, `fundraiser_updated`, `fundraiser_deleted`

- `data` (object) — Campaign details.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `partner_id` (integer) — Site ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `description` (string | null) — Campaign description.
  - `url` (string | null) — Full URL to the campaign.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
  - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, including the currency symbol.
  - `goal_type` (string) — Campaign goal type.
  - `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount attributed to the campaign.
  - `amount_matched` (number) — Amount contributed by donation matching assigned directly to the campaign.
  - `n_donors` (integer) — Number of donors.
  - `n_teams` (integer) — Number of teams in the campaign.
  - `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages in the campaign.
  - `images` (object)
    - `original` (string) — URL to the original campaign image.
  - `image` (string | null) — Campaign image ID.
  - `start_at` (string | null) — Campaign start date and time.
  - `end_at` (string | null) — Campaign end date and time.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
  - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
  - `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
    - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
    - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
    - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
    - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
    - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
    - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
  - `created_at` (string | null) — Campaign creation date and time.
  - `user` (object) — Campaign owner.
    - `id` (integer) — User ID.
    - `name` (string) — User name.
    - `email` (string) — User email.
    - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
    - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
    - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
    - `title` (string) — User title.
  - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
    - `id` (integer) — Organization ID.
    - `name` (string) — Organization name.
    - `custom_id` (string) — Organization custom ID.
  - `closed_at` (string | null) — Campaign close date and time.
  - `is_hidden` (boolean) — Whether the campaign is hidden.
  - `fundraiser_template` (object | null) — Campaign template summary, when applicable.
    - `id` (integer) — Template ID.
    - `name` (string) — Template name.
  - `changes` (object) — Included on `fundraiser_updated` events.
  - `deleted_at` (string | null) — Included on `fundraiser_deleted` events. Deletion date and time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

## Transaction events

Events: `transaction_created`, `transaction_refunded`

- `data` (object) — Transaction details.
  - `id` (integer) — Transaction ID.
  - `ref_id` (string) — Transaction reference ID.
  - `amount` (number) — Transaction total amount. On refund records, this is the amount of this refund. Returned money is negative; a return that moves no money, such as a donation-match-only return, can have an amount of zero.
  - `currency` (string) — Transaction currency.
  - `currency_symbol` (string) — Transaction currency symbol.
  - `frequency` (string) — Donation frequency.
  - `fundraiser_id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `parent_id` (integer | null) — Parent transaction ID, when applicable. For a refund, this is the original payment ID.
  - `fundraiser_page_id` (integer | null) — Personal page ID, when applicable.
  - `fundraiser_team_id` (integer | null) — Team ID, when applicable.
  - `organization_id` (integer | null) — Organization ID, when applicable.
  - `fundraiser_name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `organization_name` (string | null) — Organization name, when applicable.
  - `organization_code` (string | null) — Organization custom ID, when applicable.
  - `user_id` (integer) — Donor user ID.
  - `email` (string) — Donor email.
  - `mail` (object | null) — Mailing address when a receipt is mailed.
  - `statement_descriptor` (string | null) — Payment statement descriptor.
  - `summary` (object) — Transaction amount breakdown.
  - `upsell` (object | null) — Upsell details, when applicable.
  - `promo_code` (string | null) — Applied promo code, when applicable.
  - `billing_address` (object | null) — Billing address.
  - `dtd` (object | null) — Dedication or tribute data, when applicable.
  - `created_at` (string) — Transaction creation date and time.
  - `status` (string) — Transaction status. Refund records use `refunded`.
  - `is_refunded` (boolean) — Whether CrowdChange has marked this transaction as fully refunded. Use `status` to identify a refund record.
  - `parent` (object) — Included only when `status` is `refunded` and `parent_id` is set. Contains the original payment using the same transaction fields. Its `id` matches `parent_id`.
  - `tickets` (object[]) — Assigned tickets, when applicable.

### Full and partial refunds

`transaction_refunded` is sent when a refund transaction is created in CrowdChange, for both full and partial refunds. Each refund has its own `data.id`. Successive partial refunds share the original payment's `parent_id`; `data.amount` represents only the current refund, not the cumulative refunded amount.

`data.parent` keeps the original payment's amount and status. Its `is_refunded` field exposes CrowdChange's stored full-refund flag. A partial refund can have `data.status: "refunded"` while `data.parent.is_refunded` is `false`. The payload does not calculate a remaining balance.

The standard refund processing flow also emits the existing `transaction_created` event for the same refund record, including `parent`. If you subscribe to both events, use the refund's `data.id` to avoid counting the same refund twice.

These separate examples show only the fields relevant to refunds. Both `data` and `data.parent` also include the other transaction fields above.

**Full refund**

```json
{
  "event": "transaction_refunded",
  "data": {
    "id": 6002,
    "amount": -100,
    "parent_id": 6001,
    "status": "refunded",
    "is_refunded": false,
    "parent": {
      "id": 6001,
      "amount": 100,
      "parent_id": null,
      "status": "completed",
      "is_refunded": true
    }
  }
}
```

**Partial refund**

```json
{
  "event": "transaction_refunded",
  "data": {
    "id": 6003,
    "amount": -25,
    "parent_id": 6001,
    "status": "refunded",
    "is_refunded": false,
    "parent": {
      "id": 6001,
      "amount": 100,
      "parent_id": null,
      "status": "completed",
      "is_refunded": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Team events

Events: `fundraiser_team_created`, `fundraiser_team_updated`, `fundraiser_team_deleted`

- `data` (object) — Team details.
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `type` (string) — Team type.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the team's page.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
  - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, including the currency symbol.
  - `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the team.
  - `amount_matched` (number) — Team matched donation amount.
  - `n_donors` (integer) — Number of team donors.
  - `n_pages` (integer) — Number of personal pages on the team.
  - `images` (object)
    - `original` (string) — URL to the original team image.
  - `image` (string | null) — Team image ID.
  - `description` (string | null) — Team description.
  - `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the team image is inherited from the campaign.
  - `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the team description is inherited from the campaign.
  - `created_at` (string | null) — Team creation date and time.
  - `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
  - `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
    - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
    - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
    - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
    - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
    - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
    - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
  - `user` (object) — Team owner.
    - `id` (integer) — User ID.
    - `name` (string) — User name.
    - `email` (string) — User email.
    - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
    - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
    - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
    - `title` (string) — User title.
  - `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
    - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
    - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
    - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
    - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
    - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
    - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
    - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
    - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
  - `changes` (object) — Included on `fundraiser_team_updated` events.
  - `deleted_at` (string | null) — Included on `fundraiser_team_deleted` events. Deletion date and time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

## Personal page events

Events: `fundraiser_page_created`, `fundraiser_page_updated`, `fundraiser_page_deleted`

- `data` (object) — Personal page details.
  - `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
  - `name` (string) — Personal page name.
  - `type` (string) — Personal page type.
  - `url` (string | null) — URL to the personal page.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
  - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount, including the currency symbol.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, including the currency symbol.
  - `amount_pledged` (number) — Pending offline donation amount for the personal page.
  - `amount_matched` (number) — Personal page matched donation amount.
  - `n_donors` (integer) — Number of personal page donors.
  - `images` (object)
    - `original` (string) — URL to the original personal page image.
  - `image` (string | null) — Personal page image ID.
  - `description` (string | null) — Personal page description.
  - `is_default_image` (boolean) — Whether the personal page image is inherited from the campaign.
  - `is_default_description` (boolean) — Whether the personal page description is inherited from the campaign.
  - `registrant` (object | null) — Registrant details, when available.
    - `first_name` (string) — Registrant first name.
    - `last_name` (string) — Registrant last name.
  - `archived_at` (string | null) — Personal page archive date and time.
  - `closed_at` (string | null) — Personal page close date and time.
  - `created_at` (string | null) — Personal page creation date and time.
  - `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`.
  - `custom_data` (object[]) — Custom questions and responses configured for the resource.
    - `field_id` (integer) — Custom field ID.
    - `source_id` (integer | null) — Source field ID when the field was copied from a Blueprint.
    - `name` (string) — Custom field label.
    - `content` (string | null) — Formatted response to the custom field.
    - `field_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the field.
    - `response_custom_id` (string | null) — Custom ID for the selected response, when applicable.
  - `user` (object) — Personal page owner.
    - `id` (integer) — User ID.
    - `name` (string) — User name.
    - `email` (string) — User email.
    - `contact_email` (string) — User contact email.
    - `first_name` (string) — User first name.
    - `last_name` (string) — User last name.
    - `title` (string) — User title.
  - `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
    - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
    - `url` (string | null) — URL to the campaign.
    - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign goal amount.
    - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
    - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign.
    - `language` (string) — Campaign language.
    - `tags_list` (any[]) — Campaign tags.
    - `organization` (object | null) — Campaign organization, when applicable.
  - `team` (object | null) — Team summary, when the personal page belongs to a team.
    - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
    - `name` (string) — Team name.
    - `url` (string | null) — URL to the team page.
    - `amount_goal` (number) — Team goal amount.
    - `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted team goal amount.
    - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
    - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team.
    - `language` (string) — Team language.
  - `changes` (object) — Included on `fundraiser_page_updated` events.
  - `deleted_at` (string | null) — Included on `fundraiser_page_deleted` events. Deletion date and time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

## Tax receipt events

Events: `tax_receipt_issued`

- `data` (object) — Tax receipt details.
  - `id` (integer) — Tax receipt ID.
  - `transaction_id` (integer) — Transaction ID.
  - `amount_donation` (number) — Donation amount.
  - `amount_benefit` (number) — Benefit amount.
  - `amount_eligible` (number) — Tax-eligible amount.
  - `business_name` (string | null) — Business name, when applicable.
  - `name_on_receipt` (string) — Name printed on the receipt.
  - `issued_on` (string) — Receipt issue date and time.
  - `receipt_number` (string) — Receipt number.
  - `status` (string) — Receipt status. Values are `valid` or `cancelled`.
  - `first_name` (string) — Recipient first name.
  - `last_name` (string) — Recipient last name.
  - `title` (string | null) — Recipient title.
  - `email` (string) — Recipient email.
  - `street_address` (string) — Recipient street address.
  - `state` (string) — Recipient state or province.
  - `country` (string) — Recipient country.
  - `postal` (string) — Recipient postal code.
  - `city` (string) — Recipient city.

## Milestone events

Events: `milestone_triggered`

Sent when a milestone notification is triggered for the original recipient. Additional recipient emails configured on the milestone are not included in the webhook payload.

- `data` (object) — Milestone details.
  - `id` (integer) — Milestone log ID.
  - `mail_template_id` (integer) — Mail template ID.
  - `template_name` (string) — Mail template name.
  - `type` (string) — Mail template type.
  - `trigger_id` (string) — Milestone trigger identifier.
  - `trigger_group` (string) — Trigger recipient group.
  - `trigger_type` (string) — Trigger value type, such as `amount` or `percent`.
  - `trigger_value` (string) — Configured milestone trigger value.
  - `trigger_data` (object) — Additional trigger data. Additional recipient emails are excluded.
  - `queued_at` (string) — Date and time the notification was queued.
  - `recipient` (object) — Original milestone recipient.
  - `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign summary.
  - `fundraiser_team` (object | null) — Team that reached the milestone, when applicable.
  - `fundraiser_page` (object | null) — Personal page that reached the milestone, when applicable.

# Goal / Raised Amounts

> Retrieve the goal amount, raised amount, donor count, and core campaign metadata for a specific CrowdChange campaign by its fundraiser ID.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/fundraiser/{id}`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Fundraiser ID.

## Query parameters

- `only_received` (boolean, query) — Include only received transactions for raised amount. Default: `false`

## Response

- `type` (string) — Goal type. Allowed values: `amount`, `donors`
- `goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `raised` (number) — Raised amount.
- `donors` (number) — Number of participants.
- `n_teams` (number) — Number of teams in the campaign.
- `n_pages` (number) — Number of personal pages in the campaign.
- `name` (string) — Campaign name.
- `description` (string) — Campaign description.
- `images` (object) — Campaign images.
- `event` (object) — Event dates for the campaign.
  - `start_at` (string) — Event start date and time.
  - `end_at` (string) — Event end date and time.
  - `address` (string | null) — Legacy event address.
- `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
- `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
- `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "type": "amount",
  "goal": 10000,
  "raised": 5000,
  "donors": 25,
  "n_teams": 10,
  "n_pages": 25,
  "name": "Gala Night",
  "description": "Help us reach our goal and make a difference!",
  "images": {
    "original": "https://img.crowdchange.dev/files/abc.png"
  },
  "event": {
    "start_at": "2024-01-01 18:00:00",
    "end_at": "2024-01-01 22:00:00"
  }
}
```

# Donors List

> Retrieve a paginated list of donors for a specific CrowdChange campaign, returning 10 donor records per page with name, amount, and donation date.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/fundraiser/{id}/donors`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Fundraiser ID.

## Query parameters

- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `id`, `amount` Default: `id`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc` Default: `desc`
- `min_total` (integer, query) — Minimum total donation amount to include. Default: `0`
- `only_received` (boolean, query) — Include only received transactions. Default: `false`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `total` (number) — Donation total.
- `total_formatted` (string) — Formatted donation total, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_match` (number) — Matched amount for campaigns with donation matching enabled.
- `total_with_match` (number) — Donation total including the matched amount.
- `name` (string) — Donor's name or alias.
- `comment` (string) — Donor's comment.
- `is_amount_hidden` (boolean) — True if the donor chose to hide their donation amount.
- `currency` (string) — Currency code.
- `created_at` (string) — Date and time of the donation.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "total": 100,
    "total_formatted": "$100",
    "amount_match": 100,
    "total_with_match": 200,
    "name": "John Snow",
    "comment": "Happy to support!",
    "is_amount_hidden": false,
    "currency": "USD",
    "created_at": "2021-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `amount_raised` (number) — Total raised amount

- `country` (string) — Country code
- `state` (string) — State or province.

# Find Campaign

> Search CrowdChange campaigns by keyword and retrieve a paginated list of matching fundraisers with goal, raised, and status data for each.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/fundraisers/search`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `fundraisers` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser ids.
- `templates` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser template (blueprint) ids.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `include_closed` (integer, query) — Include closed campaigns. Default: `0`
- `include_hidden` (integer, query) — Include hidden campaigns. Default: `0`
- `include_subsites` (integer, query) — Include data from subsites. Default: `0`
- `amount_raised` (object, query) — Campaign's amount raised filter.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `name` (string) — Campaign name.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the campaign, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the campaign.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `n_teams` (number) — Number of teams in the campaign.
- `n_pages` (number) — Number of personal pages in the campaign.
- `url` (string) — URL to campaign.
- `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `is_hidden` (boolean) — True if campaign is hidden, otherwise false.
- `closed_at` (string) — Campaign closed at
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Campaign owner's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Campaign owner's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Campaign owner's last name
  - `title` (string) — Campaign owner's title
- `organization` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
  - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
  - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to original campaign's image.
- `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
- `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
- `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Campaign",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "n_teams": 5,
    "n_pages": 15,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2",
    "language": "en",
    "is_hidden": false,
    "closed_at": "2022-03-01 00:00:00",
    "user": {
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr."
    },
    "organization": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Crowdchange",
      "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
    },
    "images": {
      "original": "https://img.crowdchange.dev/files/abc.png"
    }
  }
]
```

# Find Team

> Search CrowdChange fundraising teams by keyword and retrieve a paginated list of matching teams with goal, raised amount, and campaign details.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/teams/search`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `fundraiser_page_id` (integer, query) — Returns specific personal page if provided.
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer, query) — ID of the team to filter by.
- `fundraisers` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser ids.
- `templates` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser template (blueprint) ids.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `include_hidden` (integer, query) — Include teams from hidden campaigns. Default: `0`
- `include_subsites` (integer, query) — Include data from subsites. Default: `0`
- `amount_raised` (object, query) — Team's amount raised filter.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `description` (string) — Team description
- `image` (string) — Team image ID
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the team, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `url` (string) — URL to team's page.
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of pages.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign that team belongs to.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to campaign's page.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `organization` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
    - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
    - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Team captain's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Team captain's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Team captain's last name
  - `title` (string) — Team captain's title

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Team A",
    "description": "Team description",
    "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1/team/2",
    "language": "en",
    "n_pages": 50,
    "fundraiser": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1",
      "language": "en",
      "organization": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Crowdchange",
        "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
      }
    },
    "user": {
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr."
    }
  }
]
```

# Get Team

> Retrieve a single CrowdChange fundraising team by ID, including parent campaign, captain, member count, goal, and total raised so far.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/teams/{id}`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Team ID.

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `description` (string) — Team description
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to image.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the team, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of pages.
- `url` (string) — URL to team's page.
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign that team belongs to.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to campaign's page.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `organization` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
    - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
    - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Team captain's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Team captain's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Team captain's last name
  - `title` (string) — Team captain's title

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

```json

  "id": 1,
  "name": "Team A",

    "original": "https://img.crowdchange.dev/files/abc.png"
```

# Find Personal Page

> Search public CrowdChange personal fundraising pages by keyword and retrieve a paginated list of matches with goal, raised, and owner details.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/personal-pages/search`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `fundraiser_team_id` (integer, query) — Team id. Returns specific team if provided.
- `fundraisers` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser ids.
- `templates` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser template (blueprint) ids.
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `sort` (string, query) — Key to sort by. Allowed values: `name`, `amount_raised`, `amount_goal`
- `direction` (string, query) — Direction of sorting. Allowed values: `asc`, `desc`
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `include_hidden` (integer, query) — Include personal pages from hidden campaigns. Default: `0`
- `include_subsites` (integer, query) — Include data from subsites. Default: `0`
- `include_description` (boolean, query) — Include the personal page description in the response. The returned `description` is plain text with all HTML removed and truncated to 200 characters. Default: `false`
- `amount_raised` (object, query) — Personal page's amount raised filter.

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `description` (string) — Personal page description as plain text with all HTML removed, truncated to 200 characters. Only returned when `include_description` is set.
- `image` (string) — Personal page image ID
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the personal page, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `url` (string) — Full URL to personal page.
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `team` (object) — Team name that personal page belongs to (if assigned to a team).
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to team's page.
  - `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign that personal page belongs to.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — URL to campaign's page.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `organization` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
    - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
    - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Personal page owner's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Personal page owner's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Personal page owner's last name
  - `title` (string) — Personal page owner's title

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "John Snow",
    "description": "Help us reach our goal and make a difference!",
    "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2/page/1",
    "language": "en",
    "team": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1/team/2",
      "language": "en"
    },
    "fundraiser": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1",
      "language": "en",
      "organization": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Crowdchange",
        "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
      }
    },
    "user": {
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr."
    }
  }
```

# Get Personal Page

> Retrieve a single CrowdChange personal fundraising page by ID, including owner, parent campaign, goal, raised amount, and recent donor activity.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/personal-pages/{id}`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Path parameters

- `id` (integer, path, **required**) — Personal page ID.

## Query parameters

- `include_description` (boolean, query) — Include the full personal page description in the response. Default: `false`

## Response

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `description` (string) — Full personal page description. May contain HTML. Only returned when `include_description` is set.
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to image.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the personal page, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `url` (string) — Full URL to personal page.
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `team` (object) — Team name that personal page belongs to (if assigned to a team).
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to team's page.
  - `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign that personal page belongs to.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — URL to campaign's page.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `organization` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
    - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
    - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Personal page owner's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Personal page owner's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Personal page owner's last name
  - `title` (string) — Personal page owner's title

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "John Snow",
  "description": "Help us reach our goal and make a difference!",
  "images": {
    "original": "https://img.crowdchange.dev/files/abc.png"
  },
  "amount_goal": 1000,
  "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
  "amount_raised": 550,
  "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
  "n_donors": 10,
  "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2/page/1",
  "language": "en",
  "team": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Gala Night",
    "amount_goal": 10000,
    "amount_raised": 8000,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",

  "fundraiser": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Gala Night",
    "amount_goal": 10000,
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/client-side/global-apis/get_v2-client-activity-trackers-leaderboard | Nav: API Reference > Client Side APIs > Global APIs > Activities Leaderboard | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Activities Leaderboard

> Retrieve the activity tracker leaderboard of personal pages, returning 10 participants per page ranked by tracked steps, distance, or minutes.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/activity-trackers/leaderboard`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `basis` (string, query, **required**) — Basis of activity. Allowed values: `distance`, `time`, `daily`
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `activity_type` (string, query) — Activity type name.
- `include_archived` (integer, query) — Include archived activities. Default: `0`
- `include_finished` (integer, query) — Include finished activities. Default: `0`
- `fundraiser_id` (integer, query) — Filter by campaign ID.
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `total` (number) — Tracked value.
- `activity_tracker` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Activity's name.
  - `basis` (string) — Activity basis' name. Allowed values: `daily`, `time`, `distance`
  - `types` (object[]) — List of activity types.
    - `name` (string) — Activity type's name.
    - `total` (number) — Activity type's tracked value.
- `fundraiser_page` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Personal page name.
  - `fundraiser` (object)
    - `name` (string) — Campaign that personal page belongs to.
    - `organization` (object)
      - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name.
  - `team` (object)
    - `name` (string) — Team name that personal page belongs to (if assigned to a team).

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

# Activities Teams Leaderboard

> Retrieve the activity tracker teams leaderboard with up to 10 teams per page, ranked by tracked steps, distance, or activity minutes raised.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/activity-trackers/leaderboard/teams`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `basis` (string, query, **required**) — Basis of activity. Allowed values: `distance`, `time`, `daily`
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`
- `text` (string, query) — Search term.
- `activity_type` (string, query) — Activity type name.
- `include_archived` (integer, query) — Include archived activities. Default: `0`
- `include_finished` (integer, query) — Include finished activities. Default: `0`
- `fundraiser_id` (integer, query) — Filter by campaign ID.
- `lang` (string, query) — API's locale. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `total` (number) — Tracked value.
- `activity_tracker` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Activity's name.
  - `basis` (string) — Activity basis' name. Allowed values: `daily`, `time`, `distance`
  - `types` (object[]) — List of activity types.
    - `name` (string) — Activity type's name.
    - `total` (number) — Activity type's tracked value.
- `fundraiser_team` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `fundraiser` (object)
    - `name` (string) — Campaign that team belongs to.
    - `organization` (object)
      - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "total": 1000,
    "activity_tracker": {
      "name": "Activity name.",
      "basis": "distance",
      "types": [
        {
          "name": "Run.",

]
```

# Site wide stats

> Retrieve site-wide aggregated stats across all CrowdChange campaigns, including total raised, donor count, and number of active fundraisers.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/wl/stats`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `templates` (string, query) — Comma separated list of fundraiser template (blueprint) ids.

## Response

- `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by all campaigns.
- `n_fundraisers` (number) — Number of campaigns on the site.
- `n_teams` (number) — Number of teams across all campaigns.
- `n_pages` (number) — Number of personal pages across all campaigns.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of participants.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
{
  "amount_raised": 10000,
  "n_fundraisers": 50,
  "n_teams": 50,
  "n_pages": 50,
  "n_donors": 2500
}
```

<!-- Source: https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev/api-reference/client-side/top-daily/get_v2-client-fundraisers-top-daily | Nav: API Reference > Client Side APIs > Top Daily > Top Daily Campaigns | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Top Daily Campaigns

> Retrieve the daily ranking of top CrowdChange campaigns by amount raised over the last 24 hours, ideal for a leaderboard or homepage widget.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/fundraisers/top/daily`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `timezone` (string, query) — Timezone identifier. Default: `UTC`
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
- `name` (string) — Campaign name.
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the campaign, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the campaign.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `n_teams` (number) — Number of teams in the campaign.
- `n_pages` (number) — Number of personal pages in the campaign.
- `url` (string) — URL to campaign.
- `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `is_hidden` (boolean) — True if campaign is hidden, otherwise false.
- `closed_at` (string) — Campaign closed at
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Campaign owner's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Campaign owner's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Campaign owner's last name
  - `title` (string) — Campaign owner's title
- `organization` (object)
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
  - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
  - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
- `images` (object)
  - `original` (string) — URL to original campaign's image.
- `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
- `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
- `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Campaign",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "n_teams": 5,
    "n_pages": 15,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2",
    "language": "en",
    "is_hidden": false,
    "closed_at": "2022-03-01 00:00:00",
    "user": {
      "name": "John Snow",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Snow",
      "title": "Mr."
    },
    "organization": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Crowdchange",
      "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
    },
    "images": {
      "original": "https://img.crowdchange.dev/files/abc.png"
    }
  }
]
```

# Top Daily Teams

> Retrieve the daily ranking of top CrowdChange fundraising teams by amount raised over the last 24 hours, for leaderboards and homepage widgets.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/teams/top/daily`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `timezone` (string, query) — Timezone identifier. Default: `UTC`
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Team ID.
- `name` (string) — Team name.
- `description` (string) — Team description
- `image` (string) — Team image ID
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the team, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the team.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `url` (string) — URL to team's page.
- `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `n_pages` (integer) — Number of pages.
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign that team belongs to.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to campaign's page.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `organization` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
    - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
    - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Team captain's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Team captain's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Team captain's last name
  - `title` (string) — Team captain's title

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json

  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Team A",
    "description": "Team description",
    "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",

    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
```

# Top Daily Pages

> Retrieve the daily ranking of top CrowdChange personal fundraising pages by amount raised over the last 24 hours, for leaderboards and widgets.

**Endpoint:** `GET /v2/client/personal-pages/top/daily`  
**Surface:** Client Side API · **Auth:** API key — `Authorization: Bearer {api-key}` header  
**Base URLs:** Production (US) `https://api.crowdchange.co` · Production (CA) `https://api.crowdchange.ca` · Development `https://api.crowdchange.dev` (see [Overview](../../overview.md))

## Query parameters

- `timezone` (string, query) — Timezone identifier. Default: `UTC`
- `page` (integer, query) — Page number. Default: `1`
- `limit` (integer, query) — Number of results to return. Default: `10`

## Response

Returns an array of objects with the following fields.

- `id` (integer) — Personal page ID.
- `name` (string) — Personal page name.
- `image` (string) — Personal page image ID
- `amount_goal` (number) — Goal amount.
- `amount_goal_formatted` (string) — Formatted goal amount of the personal page, includes currency symbol.
- `amount_raised` (number) — Amount raised by the personal page.
- `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the personal page, includes currency symbol.
- `n_donors` (number) — Number of donors
- `url` (string) — Full URL to personal page.
- `language` (string) — Personal page language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `team` (object) — Team name that personal page belongs to (if assigned to a team).
  - `id` (integer) — Team ID.
  - `name` (string) — Team name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Team's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the team.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the team, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — Full URL to team's page.
  - `language` (string) — Team language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
- `fundraiser` (object) — Campaign that personal page belongs to.
  - `id` (integer) — Campaign ID.
  - `name` (string) — Campaign name.
  - `amount_goal` (number) — Campaign's goal amount.
  - `amount_raised` (number) — Total amount raised by the campaign.
  - `amount_raised_formatted` (string) — Formatted amount raised by the campaign, includes currency symbol.
  - `url` (string) — URL to campaign's page.
  - `language` (string) — Campaign language. Allowed values: `en`, `fr`
  - `organization` (object)
    - `id` (integer) — Campaign organization's ID
    - `name` (string) — Campaign organization's name
    - `custom_id` (string) — Campaign organization's Custom ID
  - `location_type` (string | null) — Campaign location type. Allowed values: `venue`, `online`, `other`.
  - `location` (string | null) — Campaign location details. For a `venue`, this contains venue details; for `online`, online-event details; for `other`, free-form location text.
  - `location_data` (object | null) — Structured location data. For `venue`, contains `address` and/or `geo`; for `online`, contains `link`; otherwise `null`. Missing nested fields are omitted.
- `user` (object)
  - `name` (string) — Personal page owner's name
  - `first_name` (string) — Personal page owner's first name
  - `last_name` (string) — Personal page owner's last name
  - `title` (string) — Personal page owner's title

**Other responses**

| Status | Description |
| - | - |
| `400` | Bad Request |
| `403` | Forbidden |

**Response example:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "John Snow",
    "image": "1eaf5ab2-5d55-11ee-82ef-001c42584fa2",
    "amount_goal": 1000,
    "amount_goal_formatted": "$1,000",
    "amount_raised": 550,
    "amount_raised_formatted": "$550",
    "n_donors": 10,
    "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/2/page/1",
    "language": "en",
    "team": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1/team/2",
      "language": "en"
    },
    "fundraiser": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Gala Night",
      "amount_goal": 10000,
      "amount_raised": 8000,
      "amount_raised_formatted": "$8,000",
      "url": "https://demo.crowdchange.dev/1",
      "language": "en",
      "organization": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Crowdchange",
        "custom_id": "CrowdchangeID"
```
